title: A Note on Frobenius Character Formula
summary: In this note we give an alternative derivation of Frobenius Character Formula using wedge product, the resulting formula is used to calculate the character table of $S_{2}$ and $S_{3}$ Group which reproduces their character table correctly, calculations for classes of $S_{3}$ Group are given in the appendix B. The calculations are given in terms Schur Functions. In the first section, a brief indicative review of Symmetric Group and related formulas is given. In Section second we derive the formula. A naive approach to computational complexity is also presented at the end.
